verdict.rationale: Tavily is fundamentally API/SDK-first: search, extract, crawl, map, research, qna_search, and get_search_context are all exposed via the Python SDK/API (tavily-docs-1,3,4,10-13; tavily-gh-1,4,5,7,8,9,10), and even keyless/no-signup usage is supported (tavily-gh-2,6). There's no evidence of a separate UI offering functionality unavailable via API — the product's own docs frame it as 'the web layer for AI agents' (tavily-probe-1), consistent with API being the primary surface.  Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe-2 shows 404s) and explicit confirmation that dashboard/UI-only features (e.g., usage analytics, playground settings) have API equivalents.
